svg.aria-label: Cycloidal drive kinematic principle: the eccentric orbits, the disc falls back by one lobe per turn

g.text: One input turn = one lobe of lag
by one lobe pitch, in reverse
The disc has 6 lobes, the ring 7 rollers.
It is exactly one lobe short, so it cannot follow
the orbit — it slips back one step every turn.
Schematic view: lobe count and eccentricity are
